remarks: 3 Bedroom 2 bath single family gem now available! The layout includes a living room, dining room, and kitchen on the first floor, along with an updated full bathroom and laundry/mud room. The kitchen is equipped with granite counters, newer cabinets, and stainless steel appliances, and flows seamlessly onto the large back deck, patio, and yard - perfect for summer barbecues, lawn games, and relaxing by the fire pit. Upstairs you'll find three bedrooms and an updated full bathroom with custom shower and tile work. Additional features include an attic and full basement for storage, as well as a large shed for extra storage. Located just minutes from CT Ave, schools, parks, and popular spots like SONO Collections and Downtown SONO. This home offers the perfect blend of convenience and comfort. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity. Note: Must have good credit and good income. No pets, 2 months security.
